provider.name: SKU.io
provider.description: Inventory-management / ERP platform for multichannel ecommerce brands. REST + JSON API.

auth.obtained_via: SKU.io app → Settings → Developer → Personal Access Tokens
auth.notes: Tokens are scoped and deny-by-default. A 403 'not available to API tokens' means the token lacks the scope for that endpoint; a human must edit the token.

skills.name: search-the-sku-api
skills.title: Find the right SKU.io endpoint
skills.description: Locate the correct operation for a task using the OpenAPI spec, per-domain chunks, and the docs — before making any call.

skills.name: create-and-fulfill-an-order
skills.title: Create and fulfill a sales order
skills.description: Create a customer, place a sales order, dispatch a fulfillment, and read the order back to confirm.

skills.name: sync-inventory-levels
skills.title: Sync inventory levels from an external system
skills.description: Read current stock, diff against a source of truth, and post inventory adjustments for the differences.

skills.name: manage-products
skills.title: Create, look up, and update products
skills.description: Get SKUs into the catalog, resolve a SKU to a product id, and keep product records current.

skills.name: subscribe-to-webhooks
skills.title: Subscribe to SKU.io webhooks
skills.description: Register a webhook endpoint, choose event types, and consume pushed events instead of polling.
